module

public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Action.Pointwise.Set.Basic

@[expose] public section

open scoped Pointwise

namespace Set
variable {M : Type*} [Monoid M] {a b : M} {s : Set M}

@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma mul_mem_smul_set [IsLeftCancelMul M] : a * b ∈ a • s ↔ b ∈ s :=
  (mul_right_injective _).mem_set_image

end Set

review.notes: Checked both declarations: Set.mul_mem_smul_set and its generated additive twin Set.add_mem_vadd_set. The file introduces no definitions. Pointwise self-action is precisely the image of left multiplication/addition, and the cancellation hypotheses justify both equivalences without commutativity or invertibility. Mathlib's nearby group-action theorem has different hypotheses, so this is not a duplicate. Exact-name searches found no downstream references to either lemma; the direct importer was inspected for compatible translation semantics. Lean experiments in /workspace/review/scratch.lean and boundaries.lean verified the elaborated statements, independent proofs, empty sets, singletons, identity translations, non-group and noncommutative examples, and ZMod 0. Exhaustive computations over all pairs and subsets of the three-element and trivial groups returned true for both versions. A counterexample without left cancellation confirms that hypothesis is substantive. Neither lemma depends on sorryAx. The reviewed file matches its committed Git blob.
